events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey walkthroughs checkout, stale wording, ledger and review pages
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs 2>/dev/null && git remote -v | head -2; git branch --show-current; git status --short | head -15; git log --oneline | head -5; ls scripts/walkthroughs | head -40; ls scripts/walkthroughs/journeys; echo ---; grep -rniE "waiting (for|on) access|once access|blocked on|awaiting|not signed in|never arrived|until access|pending access" scripts/walkthroughs --include=*.md --include=*.json --include=*.tsx --include=*.ts --include=*.html --include=*.py --include=*.sh -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -30; echo ---; tail -12 scripts/walkthroughs/R

events.name: Bash
events.head: Search stale access wording, check ledger for unreverted rows, read verify script
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs && W=scripts/walkthroughs; grep -rniE "waiting (for|on) (account )?access|once access|awaiting|never arrived|until access|pending access|blocked|not signed in|no access|needs access|when access|can't (record|reach)|cannot (record|reach)" $W/journeys/{twilio,kie,dodo,stripe,hubspot,zoho,wistia,google-senders}.md $W/AGENT_BRIEF.md $W/WORKFLOW.md $W/vendor-docs.md app/public/wt-review/index.html app/public/wt-review/{twilio,kie,dodo,stripe,hubspot,zoho,wistia,google-senders}/index.html 2>&1 | cut -c1-330 | head -40; echo ---LEDGER; grep -c . $W/REVERT

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read orchestrator decisions for T-283 and T-215
events.input: $ cat workshop-plan/tasks/decisions/T-283.md 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-2500 | head -40; echo; grep -n "Stripe" workshop-plan/tasks/decisions/T-215.md | cut -c1-1500 | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the flagged journey lines and review page matches
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs && W=scripts/walkthroughs; sed -n 40,70p $W/journeys/twilio.md | cut -c1-420; echo ---DODO; sed -n 40,55p $W/journeys/dodo.md | cut -c1-900; echo ---KIE; grep -oiE ".{200}(blocked|not signed in|awaiting|no access).{200}" app/public/wt-review/kie/index.html app/public/wt-review/google-senders/index.html | head -6; echo ---STRIPE; grep -niE "docs|access|key" $W/journeys/stripe.md | cut -c1-300 | head -20; echo; for t in kie stripe hubspot zoho wistia; do echo "== $t"; grep -niE "sign(ed)? ?in|log ?in|account|access|unconfirmed|TODO|pending" $W/journe

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate decision files and related task states
events.input: $ ls workshop-plan/tasks/ | head -30; f=$(ls workshop-plan/tasks/decisions/ 2>/dev/null | grep -E "T-(283|215|350)"); echo $f; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -name "T-283.md" -print 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read flagged status lines in journey files
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs && W=scripts/walkthroughs; sed -n 58,75p $W/journeys/twilio.md | cut -c1-700; echo ---DODO; sed -n 44,52p $W/journeys/dodo.md | cut -c1-1100; echo ---GS; grep -niE "status|sign-in|signed|password|T-350|docs" $W/journeys/google-senders.md | cut -c1-300 | tail -8; echo ---STRIPE; grep -niE "docs route|T-283|T-350|sign-up|restricted" $W/journeys/stripe.md | cut -c1-350 | tail -6; echo ---KIE; grep -niE "T-283|docs only|status|sign" $W/journeys/kie.md | cut -c1-300 | tail -6; echo ---pages; grep -oiE ".{160}(blocked|not signed in|awaiting).{160}" app/p

events.name: Bash
events.head: Probe each video's resolution, duration, step count and paste steps
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs && W=scripts/walkthroughs; for t in twilio kie dodo stripe hubspot zoho wistia google-senders; do d=$W/recordings/$t; mp4=$(ls app/public/wt-review/$t/*.mp4 2>/dev/null | head -1); info=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=width,height:format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$mp4" 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' '); n=$(grep -c . $d/steps.jsonl); paste=$(grep -ciE "paste" $d/steps.jsonl); dash=$(grep -cE "—|–" $d/steps.jsonl app/public/wt-review/$t/index.html | tr '\n' ' '); echo "$t | $(basename "$mp4") | $info | steps $n | paste-steps $paste | dashe
